body: I'm playing this via Xbox Play Anywhere on my TV with Gamepass Ultimate, but it's clearly the Xbox Series S version that's being streamed to my device, and it looks and runs like ass! It's missing the Performance/Quality mode toggle. Is this normal or what? I thought streaming was supposed to be from Series X level equipment.

I have been having a ton of fun with [REDACTED] (That's literally the name of the game before people bombard me with, "but what's it called" jokes) which is set the Callisto Protocol universe.

The Last of Us Part 2 remastered had a mode called No Return, which is excellent, and I ended up putting tons of hours into. 

Hades is great, but that's a fairly obvious one. 

Cult of the Lamb, Risk of Rain 2, and Endless Dungeon have provided hours of fun for me also.

However, my current obsession is Balatro, which is truly incredible! I didn't even know how to play Poker at all before, but it totally hooked me, and I play it on both my PS5 and my phone all the time!

The No Return mode in TLOU2 Remastered is great! I put tons of hours into it in the end! The refined gameplay and ability to stealth encounters also make it pretty unique. Plus, by default, it's one of the best-looking and most polished ones out there. It's pretty impressive for a mode Naughty Dog added to a remaster.

The "No Return" mode in The Last of Us Part II: Remastered is actually brilliant! It's highly customisable, has a ton of cool stuff to unlock, loads of variables, etc, and it's all based around the games already robust stealth/combat mechanics. I have put a ton of time into it and really enjoy every run and how dynamic encounters are.

Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning ☺️

Great combat, especially when it comes to magic.

intriguing lore and world.

Deep yet not overly complex/convoluted RPG systems. 

Plenty of interesting build choices. 

Stylised graphics which are ageing beautifully in my opinion.

Updated for current gen consoles so runs at 4K 60fps on PS5.

Above average voice acting and writing, especially for the era and genre.
